text.content: Marcus Whitmore (Toreador, @UUID[JournalEntry.sCVTjJFrnyyVnQDt]{Marcus Whitmore}) has ruled since 1962. He is elegant, prudent, and lazy. He prefers that problems solve themselves, and he's usually right, because he has Montgomery. He is not a good Prince in wartime, and he knows it. His greatest virtue is knowing whom to let do the work; his greatest flaw, not knowing when that work is being done by someone else.

Ethan Montgomery (Gangrel, @UUID[JournalEntry.1UgmJAqeofD7SSaf]{Ethan Montgomery}) is the law in Seattle. His pack, Whitmore's Wolves (@UUID[JournalEntry.azX1hjbc0PUp2AA2.JournalEntryPage.bxduXJhh2oXcM6Uy]{COT-01 · Whitmore's Wolves}), includes mortal bounty hunters, his childe Hal, and, as an outside ally, David. He is loyal to the Prince but doesn't respect him, and the Primogen know it.

Clan Primogen Stance
Ventrue Charles Halloway (@UUID[JournalEntry.uDNdrVnGBbAh18Tt]{Charles Halloway}) Wants the crown. Talks about “modernizing the Masquerade.”
Toreador Solène Marchetti (@UUID[JournalEntry.bB0eDKVFcxQW4C2d]{Solène Marchetti}), also Keeper of Elysium Loyal to the Prince out of habit. Neutral by trade.
Tremere Dr. Anneliese Voight (@UUID[JournalEntry.yaAsxCkCLf8CANL5]{Dr. Anneliese Voight}), Regent of the Chantry Worried about FIRSTLIGHT. Trusts neither Halloway nor Whitmore.
Nosferatu Abel Thornquist (@UUID[JournalEntry.dj4gIszHHTN1QRKk]{Abel Thornquist}) Sells to everyone. His vote is the most expensive in the city.
Malkavian Wendell Fry (@UUID[JournalEntry.AeAhHuCNHL9KWVnT]{Wendell Fry}) Holds the seat “out of habit.” Nobody knows how he'll vote, not even him.

The Brujah and Gangrel seats have been empty since those clans broke with the Camarilla.

• The Everett Anarchs (@UUID[JournalEntry.azX1hjbc0PUp2AA2.JournalEntryPage.SSDCSJFv8Esl6Ki5]{COT-03 · Salt's}), led by Rosa Iturbe (@UUID[JournalEntry.WHkwE8CYfaKW5WyO]{Rosa “Salt” Iturbe}). About fifteen Kindred. Montgomery has been watching them since 2025, and Halloway uses them as a scapegoat.
  • The remnants of the Sabbat in Tacoma. Few, old, and hidden. See @UUID[JournalEntry.Oiln4o98kvxKbOvS]{The Larchmont Building} and @UUID[JournalEntry.AnZpyM4onyACPwiC.JournalEntryPage.18vJtyOOVZe1Uk41]{GAN-09 · The Larchmont Survivor}.
  • The dockside thin-bloods. A dozen of them, protected by Thornquist in exchange for favors. Jun Takeda (@UUID[JournalEntry.BRQMU0Tf8VSNaZ5o]{Jun Takeda}) is one of them.
  • The independents. David (@UUID[JournalEntry.3zcQLj7aEAxHT0Yr]{David Smith}) is the best known. Tacoma also has a Hecata family with a funeral home that minds its own business and buries whoever it's paid to.

• FIRSTLIGHT, Puget Cell (@UUID[JournalEntry.KioeAEZP78U0Coz5]{Northline Cyber Advisory}). Special Agent Dana Okafor (@UUID[JournalEntry.bJA2iRyDgbm2TcuK]{Dana Okafor}) and analyst S. Hale (@UUID[JournalEntry.D611Mcr17F6HHEUw]{Sasha Hale}), with a six-person tactical team (@UUID[Actor.abaWg7NwNQvM0sDc]{FIRSTLIGHT Tactical Team}).
  • Gale Sentinel (@UUID[JournalEntry.zSkwEUUtkNGhfXun]{Gale Sentinel Campus and Data Center}). Home security company owned by Preston Gale (@UUID[JournalEntry.y8Ao3xEHH3W11EJe]{Preston Gale}), Halloway's ghoul.
  • Helen Ward (@UUID[JournalEntry.fVXK7vOoqn0ZL0uf]{Helen Ward}) and her podcast. More than forty thousand listeners per episode, and an archive nobody should have.

pages.name: What Does Each Faction Think of the Coterie?

text.content:
Faction Wants Sees the coterie as
Whitmore Nothing to change A useful tool, as long as it doesn't make noise
Montgomery To recover the File and find out whether Vance is alive His emergency pack, which he doesn't fully trust
Halloway The crown An obstacle he can divert or break
Voight For FIRSTLIGHT not to find the Chantry Possible allies against the Inquisition
Thornquist To buy low and sell high Customers
Rosa Iturbe For them to stop blaming Everett The Sheriff's dogs, until they prove otherwise
FIRSTLIGHT The complete index of the File Doesn't know it exists. Yet.
